data.body:
[P2] Diagnose malformed cleanup history IDs before skipping them

`reconcile_replay` also populates `after` from cleanup `histories[*].operations`, but `_cleanup_checkpoint_errors` only diagnoses non-string IDs in the replay snapshots; it silently skips them in histories. With otherwise valid lifecycle-5 evidence, a cleanup-only victim history operation containing `id: 7`, `status: SUCCEEDED`, and `endedAtMs: 30` before PENDING at 35 now produces no findings, whereas it previously produced an incomplete-evidence finding. Cleanup frames do not undergo the independent retirement shape validation, so this can turn an invalid capture into `PASSED`. Keep the guard, but explicitly diagnose malformed IDs in cleanup history operations and add a regression test covering that input path.
